'''April 2001 Cookeville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cookeville, Tennessee on 14 April 2001. [[Mike Wudhapitak]] won it. It is known from Mike Wudhapitak's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2090">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-16-cookeville-tennessee-4-14-01d2090/ cookeville-tennessee-4-14-01], DeckTech (Mike "Anime Knight" Wudhapitak, 16 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-16-cookeville-tennessee-4-14-01d2090/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Cookeville, Tennessee
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Mike Wudhapitak]]
